rules.statement: The plaintiff did not inherit any share of the property from Vaithinather as she was a child of his fourth marriage, and only children of his first marriage would have been entitled to inherit it.
rules.supporting_quote: "It appeared to us that this submission was accepted by learned counsel for the plaintiff as a correct statement of the law, but after the record was received back he intimated to us that if the finding on the fresh evidence that the property had been acquired by Vaithinather were affirmed he would contend that, on. the death of Vaithinather's. first wife, one half of the property devolved on the children, of the first marriage and that upon the death of Vaithinather the remaining half devolved equally on all his children."
